serial_launch_repair.initial_problem: Five one-rank checks were initially launched with buoyantPimpleFoam -parallel. OpenFOAM rejected that launch before time integration. Final successful jobs used the serial executable, four MPI ranks for the 27 g/s fine case, and two MPI ranks for the 77 g/s fine case.
serial_launch_repair.old_logs: *-run.log retains the first launch error; *-serial-repair.log retains recovery attempts. For 27 g/s fine, *-clean-recovery.log is the final accepted run. Native archives contain the final successful solver log.
serial_launch_repair.result_policy: Only completed 10-second runs passing every numerical screen enter the comparison.

mesh_repair.initial_problem: Two compact low-flow meshes failed small cell-determinant checks in the far field. No CFD result from a rejected mesh was accepted.
mesh_repair.change: Capped far-field cell spacing; rebuilt, passed full checkMesh, then reran. Rejected native mesh attempts retained as results/*-rejected-mesh.zip.

audit_handoff_repair.problem: The earlier scheduler waited only for running status; it could relaunch while status was solver ended; audit pending. This occurred on the 27 g/s fine case.
audit_handoff_repair.change: Scheduler now waits through the audit-pending state. Duplicate case stopped. Entire 27 g/s fine simulation rerun from time zero with four MPI ranks. The successful clean-recovery log and native archive are the accepted run.
audit_handoff_repair.acceptance: No partial or concurrently overwritten history accepted.
